module: Node "AI Stop" (color ai, once_p_duration). Asks the AI to stop the vehicle (ai.setState mode "stop") and activates the stopped output when its speed drops below checkVelocity (0.01 m/s). Inputs: aiVehId (no value = player), checkVelocity (hidden). Output: stopped (flow).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

getVeh.desc: Returns the vehicle whose id is given as input, or the player's vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) without input.

work.desc: If the stop is detected, activates stopped; otherwise compares the speed (map.objects[vehId].vel) to the threshold and stores complete.
